statement_summary: Security Coordinator designated in writing
Annual risk assessment each July with SP 800-30; risks owned and treated
Risk acceptance authority; High risks never accepted
Sanctions recorded; good-faith reporting protected
Supplier checklist and security terms before access; annual FMIS SOC 2 and MSP review
Annual independent assessment
Retention of security records (3 years; no-harm determination 5 years)
Annual policy review; policies and Spanish summary available to staff
Written, risk-rated, time-limited exceptions
Named accounts only; shared field crew login retired
Role-based least privilege; irrigation control and Office folder limited
MFA for every SYS-01 user, mailbox, backup console, portal, and remote path
Departure checklist by the last day; season-end account and PIN changes
Monthly account reconciliation and forwarding rule check
15-minute computer lock; 5-minute tablet and phone lock with PIN
Sealed emergency SYS-01 administrator credential
Dealer access on request, approved, named with MFA, and logged; MSP technician list
Password length; change defaults before use; Wi-Fi password yearly; guest Wi-Fi
Irrigation program and setting changes approved and logged
Farm systems for farm work; need-to-know look-ups only
No Restricted data in personal accounts or public AI tools
Lock screens; never share passwords, PINs, or MFA codes
Training at hire and yearly in English or Spanish; verify payment changes by phone
Report suspected incidents at once
Signed acknowledgment in English or Spanish
Ransomware runbook kept and printed in the office and pump station
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour
Safety first: hand control and fertigation off before anything else
Log every incident
Breach determination under Fla. Stat. 501.171 with its date recorded; no-harm determinations documented
Meet notice deadlines in the P08 matrix; worker notices in English and Spanish
Insurer hotline first; MSP engaged; dealer only on site or by approved session
Ransom payment only with approvals and an OFAC check
Supplier incident reports logged and handled
Paper records and on-time H-2A earnings statements during an outage
Annual tabletop with the MSP and dealer; pre-season hand-operation drill
Lessons learned within 30 days
Three classification levels
Encrypt Restricted data at rest and in transit; portals for payroll and H-2A documents
Restricted data only in approved locations; Office folder not synced
Inventory of IT, OT, services, and Restricted data locations
New suppliers and tools approved before receiving data or connecting to irrigation
Approved AI tools only; no farm data to tools that reuse it for others
Wipe or certified destruction with records
Retention schedule (Produce Safety 2 years; H-2A 3 years)
90-day immutable backup with MFA; monthly SYS-01 export; controller program copy; quarterly restore test
Drone images for crops only; images of people deleted within 30 days
